import Foundation.HigherHeatTerminalClarkOcone

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open HigherHeatPolynomialCylinders HigherHeatAnalyticCylinderDomain HigherHeatCompletedPairing
open HigherHeatPairedDualCausality HigherHeatAppellPredictableFields HigherHeatAppellInnovationLimits
open HigherHeatTerminalClarkOcone HigherHeatAllChannelNormalization HigherHeatWeakTimeAdjoint
open scoped NNReal Topology BigOperators

noncomputable def reconstructed (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N : ℕ) : Dual :=
  ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (2*m-1), channel m T r (canonicalField m hm T hT N (r+1))

lemma reconstructed_probe (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N g : ℕ) :
    reconstructed m hm T hT N (core (terminalCylinder^g)) =
      PseudoPolynomialStein.moment (2*m) (parameter m T) (N+g)-
        PseudoPolynomialStein.moment (2*m) (parameter m T) N*
          PseudoPolynomialStein.moment (2*m) (parameter m T) g := by
  rw [reconstructed, ← power_reconstruction]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [pairing_core_real, pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, one_mul, terminal_moments, terminal_moments]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
  rfl

example (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : reconstructed m hm T hT 0 = 0 := by
  rw [reconstructed, ← power_reconstruction, PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_zero]
  simp

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reconstructed 2 (by decide) T hT 3 (core terminalCylinder) = -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  rw [← pow_one terminalCylinder, reconstructed_probe]
  have h4 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 1
  have h3 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_off_order 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 3 (by decide)
  norm_num [parameter] at h4 h3 ⊢
  rw [h4,h3]
  ring

  have h4 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 1
  have h8 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 2
  have h12 := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by decide) (-(T:ℝ)) 3
  norm_num [parameter, neg_pow] at h4 h8 h12 ⊢
  rw [h4,h8,h12]
  ring

example (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (N : ℕ) :
    reconstructed m hm T hT N (core (1:Cylinder)) = 0 := by
  rw [← pow_zero terminalCylinder, reconstructed_probe]
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_zero, mul_one, sub_self]
